name: unikit-gd-experiment
description: Experiment partner for game design — turns a design problem into cheap, testable experiments and keeps an honest record of what real play showed: finds experiment ideas (at least five distinct hypotheses), thinks an experiment through (precedents, design options, how a test can mislead), writes a specification card a planner can build from, evaluates player feedback (pasted text, a chat, files; several experiments and rounds) and manages the catalog (list, compare, best, failed, retest, edit, archive). A bare call starts a short conversation; nothing is saved before you approve. Reads the project only to learn what the game does, never in development terms. Writes only .unikit/gamedesign/experiments/; never edits the GDD or code. Trigger on "the first minutes are boring, what can we test", "design an experiment", "compare three hints", "here is the playtest feedback", "which experiments failed". To build a card use /unikit-plan; to tune numbers by measurement use /unikit-gd-balance.
